title: Is This Sustainable?
summary: A reflective blog post questioning the long-term sustainability of the current AI boom, examining whether rapid AI advancement can be maintained economically, environmentally, and socially.
problem_solved: Raises critical questions about the environmental and economic costs of continuous AI scaling and deployment.
why_valuable: Provides important perspectives on the unintended consequences and long-term viability of rapid AI adoption in both industry and society.
